replies.author: MLGtino
replies.body:
My opinons:

The map lacks in detail and color, bringing out basic gray and green tones in the build. To add on to that, the towers could become more grand with higher peaks and more space to fit a larger player count. The land and castle is also very flat and boring, missing texture and landscape to compliment the theme. The trees should always be custom built to show effort to an audience, and the map is just WAY too small. You'll be lucky if this map can support 20 players. For what I said before about lack of detail and texture, I mean that there are lots of basic shapes and ZERO (literally zero) variation and the color scheme. 

Not to mention a few other things, like the bounteous amount of diamonds that you have gifted the killfarmers. Lots of diamonds encourage camping and make for terrible gameplay. And not to rain on your parade, but castle theme can be/is extremely 1 dimensional unless properly executed. 

And finally, you didn't include a download, YAML coding (required to make the map function. Don't know what it is, look it up), or many screenshots. All of these are needed. You gave us four screenshots and are expecting us to know how the rest of the map looks? You could have at least supplied a world download. 

I mean other than that ya know great map 10/10 would bang
